                                                                                  Part II: Business Overview 第二部分：業務概覽




Overview of the Five Major Segments of the Company
公 司 五 大 板 塊 業務情況一覽

                      Real Estate segment
                      地產板塊
  • In 2024, contracted sales amount was approximately RMB16,629 million (including decoration contracted sales)
  • 二零二四年全年，合約銷售額約為人民幣166.29億元（包括裝修合約銷售）
  Each of the following properties achieved contracted sales of over RMB800 million in 2024:
  • YUNĒ in Shanghai
     MAHÁ Beijing
     YUNĒ in Guangzhou
  下列物業於二零二四年均取得單盤人民幣8億元以上的合約銷售：
  • 縵雲上海
     縵合北京
     縵雲廣州



                      Commercial segment
                      商業板塊
  •   In 2024, revenue from commercial properties investment was approximately HK$4,446 million
  •   二零二四年全年，商業地產投資之收益約為港幣44.46億元
  •   As at 31st December 2024, the commercial segment had a landbank of approximately 7.27 million sq.m., of which 95% were located in first-tier cities
  •   截至二零二四年十二月三十一日，商業板塊土地儲備約727萬平方米，其中95%位處一綫城市



                      Property management segment
                      物業管理板塊
  •   In 2024, property management segment income was approximately HK$1,304 million
  •   二零二四年全年，物業管理板塊收入約為13.04億港元
  •   The property management segment is divided into two major segments (i.e. hooplife technology and property management)
  •   物業管理板塊分為合生活科技及物業管理兩大板塊
  •   In 2024, the Group has fully launched the “Building Homes with Ingenuity” campaign in more than 200 projects in over 30 cities across the country,
      taking 85 service contacts as the starting point
  •   二零二四年，集團在全國30餘座城市200多個項目全面啟動「匠心築家」行動，以85項服務觸點為抓手



                      Investments segment
                      投資板塊
  •   In 2024, the Group’s investments losses in the primary and the secondary market amounted to approximately HK$97 million
  •   二零二四年全年，集團於一級市場及二級市場之投資虧損約為0.97億港元
  •   As at 31st December 2024, financial assets at fair value through other comprehensive income amounted to approximately HK$2,325 million; and
      financial assets at fair value through profit or loss amounted to approximately HK$1,156 million
  •   截至二零二四年十二月三十一日，按公平值透過其他全面收入列賬之財務資產約為23.25億港元；按公平值透過損益列賬之財務資
      產約為11.56億港元



                      Infrastructure segment
                      基建板塊
  •   In 2024, infrastructure income before elimination was approximately HK$6,030 million
  •   二零二四年全年，抵銷前基建收入約60.30億港元
  •   During the year, completed construction area was approximately 0.83 million sq.m.
  •   本年竣工面積約83萬平方米
  •   Comprehensive improvement in the informatisation system in terms of business management, operation control, and system intelligence,
      automation, and user experience
  •   信息化體系在企業經營管理運營管控和系統智能化、自動化、用戶體驗全面 提升

C. Risk Management                                                            C. 風險管理

adverse changes in market prices in the Group’s business activities. The      利變動而使集團自有資金投資的相關業務發生

 development” of shopping malls at the main forum of the conference. Based on the ESG work framework of the Group,
 Hopson Commercial, as a value creator of the commercial ecological chain, has been creating a green and sustainable “connection”
 value in combination with the actual operation and management of commercial real estate. There are three main focuses of
 Hopson Commercial’s green connection: first, energy conservation and consumption reduction through spatial connection;
 second, balance of supply and demand through data connection; and third, value cycle through management connection.

 立 足 於 本 集 團 ESG 工 作 框 架，作 為 商 業 生 態 鏈 價 值 創 造 者，結 合 商 業 地 產 運 營 管 理 工 作 實 際，一 直 在 創 造 一 種 綠
 色、可 持 續 的「連 結」價 值。合 生 商 業 的 綠 色 連 結 主 要 有 三 大 重 點：一 是 空 間 連 結 節 能 降 耗；二 是 資 料 鏈 接 供 需 平

    An associate is an entity in which the Group has a long-term                 聯 營 公 司 為 本 集 團 於 其 一 般 不 少 於 20%

    assets of the joint venture. Joint control is the contractually agreed       聯 合 安 排。共 同 控 制 權 乃 指 合 約 協 定 分 享
    sharing of control of an arrangement, which exists only when                 控 制 權 的 安 排，其 僅 於 就 有 關 活 動 的 決 策
    decisions about the relevant activities require the unanimous                須分享控制權的各方一致同意時存在。
    consent of the parties sharing control.

    This includes the separation of embedded derivatives in host                  合同中的嵌入式衍生工具進行分 離。

    Fair value measurement                                                           公平值計量
    The Group measures its investment properties, financial assets                   本集團於各報告期末按公平值計量投資
    at fair value through other comprehensive income and financial                   物 業、按 公 平 值 透 過 其 他 全 面 收 入 列 賬 之
    assets at fair value through profit or loss at fair value at the end             財務資產及按公平值透過損益列賬之財
    of each reporting period. Fair value is the price that would be                  務 資 產。公 平 值 指 於 計 量 日 市 場 參 與 者 之
    received to sell an asset or paid to transfer a liability in an orderly          間 的 有 序 交 易 中，就 出 售 資 產 所 收 取 之 價
    transaction between market participants at the measurement date.                 格 或 轉 讓 負 債 所 支 付 之 價 格。計 量 公 平 值
    The fair value measurement is based on the presumption that the                  時假設出售資產或轉讓負債之交易於資
    transaction to sell the asset or transfer the liability takes place either       產 或 負 債 的 主 要 市 場 或（在 未 有 主 要 市 場
    in the principal market for the asset or liability, or in the absence            的 情 況 下）最 有 利 市 場 進 行。主 要 或 最 有
    of a principal market, in the most advantageous market for the                   利 市 場 須 為 本 集 團 能 參 與 的 市 場。假 設 市
    asset or liability. The principal or the most advantageous market                場 參 與 者 基 於 最 佳 經 濟 利 益 行 事，資 產 或
    must be accessible by the Group. The fair value of an asset or a                 負債的公平值使用市場參與者為資產或
    liability is measured using the assumptions that market participants             負債定價所用假設計量。
    would use when pricing the asset or liability, assuming that market
    participants act in their economic best interest.

    A fair value measurement of a non-financial asset takes into                     非財務資產之公平值計量會計及市場參
    account a market participant’s ability to generate economic benefits             與者將資產用於最高增值及最佳用途或
    by using the asset in its highest and best use or by selling it to               售予會將資產用於最高增值及最佳用途
    another market participant that would use the asset in its highest               之另一名市場參與者而創造經濟利益的
    and best use.                                                                    能力。

    The Group uses valuation techniques that are appropriate in                      本集團針對不同情況使用不同估值方
    the circumstances and for which sufficient data are available to                 法，確 保 有 足 夠 數 據 計 量 公 平 值，並 盡 量
    measure fair value, maximising the use of relevant observable                    利 用 相 關 可 觀 察 數 據，減 少 使 用 不 可 觀 察
    inputs and minimising the use of unobservable inputs.                            數據。

    hierarchy, described as follows, based on the lowest level input that            屬重要之最低層輸入數據按下述公平值
    is significant to the fair value measurement as a whole:                         層級分類：

    Level 1— based on quoted prices (unadjusted) in active markets                   第1 級 — 按 同 等 資 產 或 負 債 於 活 躍 市 場
             for identical assets or liabilities                                            之報價（未經調整）計算

    Level 2— based on valuation techniques for which the lowest level                第2級 — 按 估 值 方 法 計 算（計 量 公 平 值
             input that is significant to the fair value measurement is                    的重要最低層輸入數據可直接
             observable, either directly or indirectly                                     或間接觀察）

    Level 3— based on valuation techniques for which the lowest level                第 3級 — 按 估 值 方 法 計 算（計 量 公 平 值
             input that is significant to the fair value measurement is                     的重要最低層輸入數據不可觀

    The Group recognises an allowance for expected credit losses (“ECLs”)               本集團就所有並非按公平值透過損益列

    flows due in accordance with the contract and all the cash flows                    乃基於合約所應收的合約現金流與本集
    that the Group expects to receive, discounted at an approximation                   團預期將收取的全部現金流之差額所釐
    of the original effective interest rate. The expected cash flows will               定，並 按 原 有 實 際 利 率 的 近 似 值 進 行 貼
    include cash flows from the sale of collateral held or other credit                 現。預 期 現 金 流 包 括 來 自 出 售 持 有 的 抵 押
    enhancements that are integral to the contractual terms.                            品 或 其 他 信 貸 改 善 條 件（為 合 約 條 件 之 組
                                                                                        成部分）。

    General approach                                                                   一般方式

    initial recognition, ECLs are provided for credit losses that result               期 信 貸 虧 損 以 未 來 12 個 月 內 可 能 發 生 違
    from default events that are possible within the next 12 months (a                 約 事 件 而 導 致 的 信 貸 虧 損（12 個 月 預 期 信
    12-month ECL). For those credit exposures for which there has                      貸 虧 損）計 提。自 初 始 確 認 後 的 信 貸 風 險
    been a significant increase in credit risk since initial recognition,              已 顯 著 增 加 者，不 論 何 時 發 生 違 約，於 餘

46 Financial Risk Management Objectives and                                  46 金融風險管理目標及政策
   Policies

    The Group’s activities expose it to a variety of financial risks:         本 集 團 之 業 務 令 其 承 受 多 種 財 務 風 險：
    foreign exchange risk, credit risk, liquidity risk and cash flow and      外 匯 風 險、信 貸 風 險、流 動 資 金 風 險 及 現
    fair value interest-rate risk. The Group’s overall risk management        金 流 及 公 平 值 利 率 風 險。本 集 團 的 整 體 風
    policy focuses on the unpredictability of financial markets and           險管理政策專注於金融市場的不可預測
